title: Announcing The Wide Yorker: the most detailed cricket simulation ever made, and you’re the manager
author: Temporary-Tangelo365
selftext:
[www.thewideyorker.com](http://www.thewideyorker.com)

Hey folks,

More and more cricket games are flooding your feeds. I have seen them, played them but all feel flat and very basic. I am a huge football manager fan and wanted to get the same level of depth; So, I built one for myself. I did not built it to be shared I built it for for myself to play. I am now sharing it because I am having a lot of fun with the game. And after many many many hours playing it I feel why should I have all the fun. Give it a shot and let me know : It is available at [www.thewideyorker.com](http://www.thewideyorker.com/) . It plays on your browser (not for mobile phones unfortunately - too much data and information for a small screen); There are no ads and no Transcactions; No logins, no cookies. I build games for a living and this is a passion project for me (not meant for monetisation).

Trailer Here : [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=utW7bLEJpWE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=utW7bLEJpWE)

An introduction of the game from AI :

You’ve watched your team bowl a full toss on leg stump in the 19th over and thought you’d have done it differently. Now you can.

**The Wide Yorker** puts you in charge of an IPL franchise. You start with one of the ten real 2026 squads, and from there every decision is yours.

**The most detailed cricket sim ever made**

Every player has more than 20 attributes, and every one of them feeds into what happens on each ball. Their numbers aren’t made up: they’re built from each player’s real ball-by-ball record. The pitch is modelled in parts: seam, turn, bounce, grip, how it wears through the game and how much the ball swings under cloud. Form changes from innings to innings, tired bowlers lose their edge, and batters feel the pressure as the required rate climbs. The whole engine is tested against more than 1,200 real IPL matches, so scores, boundary rates and collapses land where the real game does.

**Set the tactics, ball by ball**

Tell your bowler where to bowl it: the line, the length, the yorker at the death, or straight at a batter’s weak spot. Set the field to match. Tell your batters how to approach each over, whether that’s seeing off a tough spell or going after the fifth bowler. You get the decision again at every over and every wicket. Save your favourite plans and bring them out when the matchup suits.

**Build your squad**

Set training plans across the squad and push the young players toward the roles you need. Bid in a live auction every season against nine AI franchises, with a mega auction every third year. Scout the states for uncapped talent before the other sides find them.

**Watch every ball come to life**

Every ball can be watched as a fully animated 3D highlight. The batting is built from how the shots are actually coached: cover drives, pulls, late cuts, sweeps, reverse sweeps, ramps, even the Dilscoop. Fielders dive, throw in and take catches on the rope. Fours find the real gaps in your field. Bowlers have their own wicket celebrations, and a batter takes off his helmet for a hundred. Each franchise plays at its own ground, in its own colours, in front of its own crowd, by day or under floodlights.

**With commentary to match**

Each ball comes with spoken commentary and the sound of the ground: the line and length, the shot, where it went. There’s a broadcast-style score bar on screen throughout.

Plays in your browser at [www.thewideyorker.com](http://www.thewideyorker.com/). I’d love to hear what you think, and especially what breaks.
